description: Revoke one app: its key stops working at once (401) and the app no longer counts toward the plan's app limit. It cannot be undone; to give that agent access again, register a new app with gate_create_app. To replace a leaked key but keep the app, use gate_rotate_app_key.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_revoke_app
title: Revoke an app
